title: Rhinitis and Sinusitis

content_blocks.text: Sinusitis—inflammation of paranasal sinuses; includes frontal sinus and maxillary recess in dogs; frontal and sphenopalatine
The nasal cavity communi cates directly with the sinuses; thus rhinitis and sinusitis often occur together.

Inflammation and irritation stimulate serous glandular secretion in the nasal mucosa. Opportunistic bacterial infections develop in compromised nasal mucosa causing discharge to become mucoid or mucopurulent. The inflammatory process can lead to turbinate destruction and erosion of the vasculature that results in epistaxis.
